articles.summary: Seadrill Limited ("Seadrill" or the "Company") (NYSE: SDRL) will report its third quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, November 3, after the NYSE closes for trading. The Company will host a conference call to discuss on Wednesday, November 4, at 08:00 CT / 15:00 CET. Interested participants may join the call by dialing +1 (833) 461-5787 (Conference ID: 184 972 661) at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled start time. The Company will webcast the call live on the Investor Relations section of its website, where a replay will be available afterwards. About Seadrill Seadrill is setting the standard in deepwater oil and gas drilling. With its modern fleet, experienced crews, and advanced technologies, Seadrill safely, efficiently, and responsibly unlocks oil and gas resources for national, integrated, and independent oil companies. For further information, visit www.seadrill.com . Kevin Smith Vice President – Corporate Finance and Investor Relations ir@seadrill.com Source:
articles.title: Seadrill Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call

articles.summary: Seadrill Limited ("Seadrill" or the "Company") (NYSE: SDRL) today announced contract awards and extensions for the West Carina, West Capella, Sonangol Libongos, and Sevan Louisiana . In Indonesia, the West Carina was awarded a contract with an undisclosed operator, with a total contract value of approximately $420 million for the firm term, including a mobilization fee and excluding additional services. The contract has an estimated firm duration of 880 days, with priced options for up to an additional 880 days. The program is expected to commence in the first half of 2027. In Malaysia, all remaining priced options have been exercised for the West Capella , extending current operations by 120 days and adding approximately $41 million in total contract value, excluding additional services.
